item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi bsad pa lcags kyu 'phrul gsal
item.coloph: bsad pa lcags kyu 'phrul gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rim par brgyud nas klu grub ye shes snying pos man ngag sgron ma zab thus kyi skor du gsungs te/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i thugs kyi bcud phyung nas/ blon chen mu thur la gdams/ phyis sprel lo'i rgyal gyi nya la bdag la brgyud bzhin/ dgra la dgra gshed (stag sprel) sprad phyir me stag zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes la bdag btsun pa kun dga' tshul khrims kyis yi ger phab pa'o//
